# RewardsPro legacy Lambda handlers

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/rewardspro/lambda)

Handle the legacy Shopify webhook, order queue and scheduled-job integrations described by RewardsPro.

**Scope:** Nested support package outside the root pnpm workspace patterns. Deployment commands affect AWS and require their own authorization.

**Placement:** Nested package outside the root workspace; package `rewardspro-webhooks-lambda`.
